name: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar
summary: Mountaineer Kadrell sends you north from Loch Modan to join Rockgar at Dun Algaz. Rockgar is organizing an expedition into the sodden lowlands of the Wetlands, along the pass between the dwarven homeland and the northern territories.

sections.title: The Road to the North Gate
sections.body: Dun Algaz cuts through the northern ridge, linking Loch Modan with the marshy Wetlands. The fortified pass carries trade, messengers, and military detachments between Ironforge and Alliance settlements farther north. With tensions rising along the borders, Mountaineer Kadrell watches travelers on the road and recruits hardy volunteers for the northern outposts.

sections.title: A Mission Gone Awry
sections.body: Mountaineer Kadrell sends recruits expecting a routine scouting expedition, but Dun Algaz proves more dangerous. At the northern gate, Mountaineer Rockgar is preparing for active conflict, not a peaceful reconnaissance trek. Hostile forces choke the pass, turning the scouting into a bitter struggle to secure the gauntlet.

faq.q: Who gives the order to report to Rockgar?
aliases: who starts report to mountaineer rockgar
faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell gives the order. He is stationed in Thelsamar across the road from the Stoutlager Inn, watching the main road toward the mountain pass.

faq.q: Where can I find Mountaineer Rockgar?
faq.answer: Mountaineer Rockgar is stationed north along the road out of Loch Modan, guarding the entrance to the tunnels of Dun Algaz.

faq.q: Why is this mission through Dun Algaz so important?
faq.answer: Dun Algaz is the main overland corridor between Loch Modan and the Wetlands. Keeping it clear protects Alliance supplies, military messages, and safe travel to Menethil Harbor and beyond.

faq.q: What happens after meeting Mountaineer Rockgar?
aliases: what comes after report to rockgar
faq.answer: Rockgar immediately enlists your help with The Algaz Gauntlet. The scouting expedition has become a bloody fight against hostile forces blocking the mountain tunnels.

faq.q: What level of adventurer should take on this assignment?
faq.answer: This assignment is for seasoned travelers around level twenty to twenty-one, finishing their duties in Loch Modan and preparing to brave the Wetlands.

faq.q: Is this quest available to Horde characters?
faq.answer: No. The Ironforge Mountaineers are loyal to King Magni Bronzebeard and the Alliance, so only Alliance travelers can accept the assignment.

angles.text: As a dwarf, answering fellow mountaineers reinforces the overland link between the Ironforge heartland and the dwarven holdings in the Wetlands.
As an Alliance traveler, securing Dun Algaz keeps the overland route to Menethil Harbor, the Alliance's main western port in the Eastern Kingdoms, open.
